title: Dodge the asteroids
description: Fly the spaceship (←/→ or A/D), shoot asteroids with the space bar and dodge them. One hit ends the game.

tasks.text: Start with Run and shoot an asteroid (space bar; the world has to be clicked).
Make the game harder: asteroids should come more often (Weltraum.act, the number in frame % 40).
Add a class Stern that slowly falls down in the background.

tasks: Give the spaceship three lives instead of one: Game Over only after the third hit.
